### ### Introduction

In this code I process proteomic and clinical data from the UK Biobank to project a proteomic signature associated with "Factor2." The analysis involves deriving a proteomic score, merging it with clinical data, calculating kidney function metrics, and phenotyping participants for baseline and incident comorbidities.

---

### ## 1. Data Loading

First, I load the necessary datasets. This includes MOFA gene loadings for Factor 2, imputed proteomics data, and two sets of clinical/phenotypic data.

```{r load-data}
# Make required files accessible in the RAP environment
# system('dx download "/UKB_CKD/data/Aachen_loadings.csv"') # Loadings per factor per cell type
# system('dx download "/UKB_CKD/data/imputed_data_vae.csv"') # A matrix of imputed proteomics data
# system('dx download "/UKB_CKD/data/data_ERC.csv"') # Basic phenotypic data
# system('dx download "/UKB_CKD/data/phenotypic_data_kidney.csv"') # Complete phenotypic data

# Load data into R dataframes
loadings   <- read.csv("Aachen_loadings.csv", sep = ",")
proteomics <- read.csv("imputed_data_vae.csv", sep = ",")
data_erc   <- read.csv("data_ERC.csv", sep = ",")
pheno_data <- read.csv("phenotypic_data_kidney.csv", sep = ",")
```

---

### ## 2. Factor 2 Proteomic Score Derivation

I derive the Factor 2 proteomic score based on Multicellular Factor Analysis (MOFA) loadings from tubular-specific cell types. I then calculate weighted score for each participant based on their proteomic profile.

```{r derive-signature}
tubular_cells <- c("PT", "TAL", "aPT_aTAL_aDCT", "dPT_dTAL_dDCT")

parse_gene <- function(x) {
  g <- str_split_fixed(x, pattern = "[\\^\\|;]", n = 2)[,1]
  g <- str_trim(g)
  g <- ifelse(g == "", NA_character_, g)
  tolower(g)
}

tubular_signature <- loadings %>%
  filter(Factor == "Factor2", view %in% tubular_cells) %>%
  mutate(Loading = as.numeric(Loading),
         gene_symbol = parse_gene(variable)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene_symbol), is.finite(Loading)) %>%
  group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
  summarise(mean_loading = mean(Loading, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_loading))
```

```{r}
protein_loading_plot <- ggplot(tubular_signature,
                               aes(x = reorder(gene_symbol, mean_loading),
                                   y = mean_loading,
                                   fill = mean_loading > 0)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", show.legend = FALSE, width = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#cb181d", "FALSE" = "#2171b5")) +
  labs(
    title = "Tubular Factor 2 Protein Loadings",
    subtitle = "Proteins ordered by mean loading value (collapsed across tubular views)",
    x = "Proteins",
    y = "Mean Loading"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5)

print(protein_loading_plot)
```

```{r}
sig_scored <- calculate_weighted_signature_score(
  proteomics_data = proteomics,
  signature_df    = tubular_signature,
  gene_col        = "gene_symbol",
  score_col       = "mean_loading",
  factor_name     = "Factor2",
  id_col          = "Sample.ID",
  anchors         = NULL,
  winsor_pct      = 0.99,
  do_l2           = TRUE,
  log2_transform  = FALSE,   
  zscale_columns  = TRUE,    
  median_impute   = FALSE,
  verbose         = TRUE
)

message(sprintf("Matched %d proteins; flipped=%s; anchor_stat=%.3f",
                attr(sig_scored, "n_common"),
                attr(sig_scored, "flipped"),
                ifelse(is.na(attr(sig_scored, "anchor_stat")), NA_real_, attr(sig_scored, "anchor_stat"))))

sig_scored$Participant.ID <- as.numeric(sig_scored$Participant.ID)
```


---

### ## 3. Data Merging and eGFR Calculation

The derived Factor 2 scores are merged with the clinical data. I then calculate the estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate (eGFR) using both the 2021 CKD-EPI creatinine equation and the creatinine-cystatin C equation.

```{r merge-and-egfr}
# Merge scores with clinical data
analysis_df <- sig_scored %>%
  left_join(data_erc, by = "Participant.ID")

# Calculate baseline eGFR using the creatinine equation
analysis_df <- analysis_df %>%
  mutate(
    Creatinine_umolL = as.numeric(Creatinine...Instance.0.participant...p30700_i0.),
    egfr = egfr.ckdepi.cr.2021(
      creatinine = Creatinine_umolL,
      age = Age.at.recruitment,
      sex = Sex,
      creatinine_units = "micromol/l"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(egfr) & !is.na(Factor2_score))

# Calculate eGFR using the creatinine-cystatin C equation
analysis_df <- analysis_df %>%
  mutate(
    Cystatin_mgl = as.numeric(Cystatin.C...Instance.0),
    egfr_cys = egfr.ckdepi.cr_cys.2021(
      creatinine = Creatinine_umolL,
      cystatin = Cystatin_mgl,
      age = Age.at.recruitment,
      sex = Sex,
      creatinine_units = "micromol/l",
      cystatin_units = "mg/L"
    )
  )
```

---

### ## 4. Phenotyping and Covariate Creation

I process the phenotypic data to derive key covariates for modeling, including medication use (RAS inhibitors) and the incidence/prevalence of major comorbidities like hypertension, heart failure, diabetes, and chronic kidney disease (CKD).

#### ### 4.1 RAS Inhibitor Use

I identify participants taking ACE inhibitors, ARBs, or ARNIs to create a composite variable for any RAS inhibitor use.

```{r medication-phenotyping}
# Define lists of RAS inhibitors
ace_inhibitors <- c("benazepril", "captopril", "enalapril", "lisinopril", "ramipril") # Abridged
arbs <- c("candesartan", "irbesartan", "losartan", "olmesartan", "valsartan") # Abridged
arnis <- c("sacubitril", "entresto")

# Identify medication columns and create flags
med_cols <- names(pheno_data)[str_detect(names(pheno_data), "^Treatment\\.medication\\.code")]

pheno_data <- pheno_data %>% 
  filter(Participant.ID %in% analysis_df$Participant.ID) %>%
  mutate(
    on_acei = find_medication(., med_cols, ace_inhibitors),
    on_arb = find_medication(., med_cols, arbs),
    on_arni = find_medication(., med_cols, arnis),
    on_ras_inhibitor = as.integer(on_acei == 1 | on_arb == 1 | on_arni == 1)
  )

# Display summary of medication use
cat("Total participants on any RAS inhibitor:", sum(pheno_data$on_ras_inhibitor), "\n")
```

#### ### 4.2 Comorbidity Phenotyping

I process ICD diagnosis dates to determine baseline and incident cases of hypertension, heart failure/cardiomyopathy, diabetes, and CKD, among others.

```{r}
# Process ICD dates to create baseline and incident flags for all phenotypes
pheno_data <- pheno_data %>%
  mutate(
    baseline_date = to_Date(Date.of.attending.assessment.centre...Instance.0),
    death_date = to_Date(Date.of.death...Instance.0),
    
    # CKD
    first_ckd = pmin_date(
      to_Date(Date.N18.first.reported..chronic.renal.failure.),
      to_Date(Date.N03.first.reported..chronic.nephritic.syndrome.),
      to_Date(Date.N04.first.reported..nephrotic.syndrome.),
      to_Date(Date.N19.first.reported..unspecified.renal.failure.),
      to_Date(Date.I12.first.reported..hypertensive.renal.disease.),
      to_Date(Date.I13.first.reported..hypertensive.heart.and.renal.disease.)
    ),

    ckd_incident = as.integer(!is.na(first_ckd) & first_ckd > baseline_date),
    ckd_incident_date = as.Date(ifelse(ckd_incident == 1, first_ckd, NA), origin = "1970-01-01"),
    
    # --- Cardiometabolic & Vascular Phenotypes ---
    first_htn = pmin_date(
        to_Date(Date.I10.first.reported..essential..primary..hypertension.), 
        to_Date(Date.I11.first.reported..hypertensive.heart.disease.)
    ),
    first_dm_all = pmin_date(
        to_Date(Date.E10.first.reported..insulin.dependent.diabetes.mellitus.),
        to_Date(Date.E11.first.reported..non.insulin.dependent.diabetes.mellitus.), 
        to_Date(Date.E14.first.reported..unspecified.diabetes.mellitus.)
    ),
    first_hfcm = pmin_date( # Heart Failure & Cardiomyopathy
        to_Date(Date.I50.first.reported..heart.failure.),
        to_Date(Date.I42.first.reported..cardiomyopathy.)
    ),
    first_mi = to_Date(Date.I21.first.reported..acute.myocardial.infarction.),
    first_ischd = pmin_date( # Ischemic Heart Disease
        to_Date(Date.I20.first.reported..angina.pectoris.),
        to_Date(Date.I25.first.reported..chronic.ischaemic.heart.disease.)
    ),
    first_atherosclerosis = to_Date(Date.I70.first.reported..atherosclerosis.),
    first_pvd = to_Date(Date.I73.first.reported..other.peripheral.vascular.diseases.),
    first_afib = to_Date(Date.I48.first.reported..atrial.fibrillation.and.flutter.),
    first_stroke = to_Date(Date.I63.first.reported..cerebral.infarction.),

    # --- Other Endocrine / Metabolic Phenotypes ---
    first_hypothyroid = to_Date(Date.E03.first.reported..other.hypothyroidism.),
    first_hyperthyroid = to_Date(`Date.E05.first.reported..thyrotoxicosis..hyperthyroidism..`),
    first_obesity = to_Date(Date.E66.first.reported..obesity.),
    first_lipidaemia = to_Date(Date.E78.first.reported..disorders.of.lipoprotein.metabolism.and.other.lipidaemias.),
    
    # --- Respiratory Phenotypes ---
    first_copd = pmin_date(
        to_Date(Date.J43.first.reported..emphysema.),
        to_Date(Date.J44.first.reported..other.chronic.obstructive.pulmonary.disease.)
    ),
    first_asthma = to_Date(Date.J45.first.reported..asthma.),
    first_ild = to_Date(Date.J84.first.reported..other.interstitial.pulmonary.diseases.), # Interstitial Lung Disease

    # --- Digestive Phenotypes ---
    first_ibd = pmin_date( # Inflammatory Bowel Disease
        to_Date(`Date.K50.first.reported..crohn.s.disease..regional.enteritis..`),
        to_Date(Date.K51.first.reported..ulcerative.colitis.)
    ),
    first_liver_disease = pmin_date(
        to_Date(Date.K70.first.reported..alcoholic.liver.disease.),
        to_Date(Date.K74.first.reported..fibrosis.and.cirrhosis.of.liver.),
        to_Date(Date.K76.first.reported..other.diseases.of.liver.)
    ),
    
    # --- Neurodegenerative Phenotypes ---
    first_alzheimers = pmin_date(
        to_Date(`Date.G30.first.reported..alzheimer.s.disease.`)
    ),
    first_parkinsons = pmin_date(
        to_Date(Date.G20.first.reported..parkinson.s.disease.)
    ),
    first_other_neurodegenerative = pmin_date(
        to_Date(Date.G31.first.reported..other.degenerative.diseases.of.nervous.system..not.elsewhere.classified.)
    ),

    # --- Musculoskeletal & Connective Tissue Phenotypes ---
    first_ra = pmin_date( # Rheumatoid Arthritis
        to_Date(Date.M05.first.reported..seropositive.rheumatoid.arthritis.),
        to_Date(Date.M06.first.reported..other.rheumatoid.arthritis.)
    ),
    first_gout = to_Date(Date.M10.first.reported..gout.),
    first_oa_knee = to_Date(`Date.M17.first.reported..gonarthrosis..arthrosis.of.knee..`), # Osteoarthritis
    first_lupus = to_Date(Date.M32.first.reported..systemic.lupus.erythematosus.),
    first_osteoporosis = to_Date(Date.M81.first.reported..osteoporosis.without.pathological.fracture.),

    # --- Genitourinary (Non-Renal) ---
    first_bph = to_Date(Date.N40.first.reported..hyperplasia.of.prostate.) # Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # --- Create Incident Flags and Dates for ALL conditions ---
    across(
      .cols = starts_with("first_"),
      .names = "incident_{.col}",
      .fns = ~ as.integer(!is.na(.x) & .x > baseline_date)
    ),
    across(
      .cols = starts_with("first_"),
      .names = "date_{.col}",
      .fns = ~ as.Date(if_else(!is.na(.x) & .x > baseline_date, .x, NA_Date_), origin = "1970-01-01")
    ),

    # --- Create Baseline (Prevalent) Flags for ALL conditions ---
    across(
      .cols = starts_with("first_"),
      .names = "baseline_{.col}",
      .fns = ~ as.integer(!is.na(.x) & .x <= baseline_date)
    )
  )

# Display the names of a subset of the newly created columns to verify
print(tail(colnames(pheno_data), 60))
```


```{r}
# 1. DEFINE CANCER GROUPS AND ICD-10 CODES
cancer_code_map <- list(
  lung_cancer = "C34",
  breast_cancer = "C50",
  liver_cancer = "C22",
  renal_cancer = "C64",
  uterine_cancer = c("C54", "C55"),
  prostate_cancer = "C61",
  soft_tissue_cancer = "C49",
  brain_cancer = "C71",
  bladder_cancer = "C67",
  skin_cancer = c("C43", "C44"),
  haematological_cancer = c(paste0("C", 81:96), "C90")
)

# 2. PREPARE DATA
pheno_data <- pheno_data %>%
  mutate(baseline_date = as.Date(Date.of.attending.assessment.centre...Instance.0))

# Identify all cancer ICD and corresponding date columns.
icd_cols <- names(pheno_data)[str_detect(names(pheno_data), "^Type\\.of\\.cancer\\.\\.ICD10")]
date_cols <- names(pheno_data)[str_detect(names(pheno_data), "^Date\\.of\\.cancer\\.diagnosis")]

pheno_data[date_cols] <- suppressWarnings(lapply(pheno_data[date_cols], as.Date))


# 3. GENERATE PREVALENT CANCER FLAGS
for (cancer_name in names(cancer_code_map)) {
  
  target_codes <- cancer_code_map[[cancer_name]]
  
  prevalent_flag <- Reduce(`|`, lapply(seq_along(icd_cols), function(i) {

    code_match <- Reduce(`|`, lapply(target_codes, function(code) str_starts(pheno_data[[icd_cols[i]]], code)))

    date_match <- !is.na(pheno_data[[date_cols[i]]]) & pheno_data[[date_cols[i]]] <= pheno_data$baseline_date
    
    code_match & date_match & !is.na(code_match)
  }))

  pheno_data[[cancer_name]] <- as.integer(prevalent_flag)
}

new_cancer_cols <- names(cancer_code_map)
print("Cancer columns:")
print(new_cancer_cols)
```

### ## 5. Final Dataset Assembly and Export

Finally, I select the relevant variables, join the datasets, create a final smoking status variable, and save the resulting analytical dataframe to an `.rds` file for use in subsequent modeling scripts.

```{r final-assembly-and-save}
# Select relevant phenotypic variables
relevant_pheno_vars <- pheno_data %>%
  select(
    Participant.ID,
    baseline_date,
    death_date,
    `Date.lost.to.follow.up`,
    `Townsend.deprivation.index.at.recruitment`,
    `Ethnic.background...Instance.0`,
    `Body.mass.index..BMI....Instance.0.participant...p21001_i0.`,
    `Smoking.status...Instance.0`,
    `Pack.years.of.smoking...Instance.0`,
    on_ras_inhibitor,
    `Glycated.haemoglobin..HbA1c....Instance.0`,                                                         
    `LDL.direct...Instance.0`,                                                                           
    `HDL.cholesterol...Instance.0`,                                                                      
    `Triglycerides...Instance.0`,                                                                        
    `C.reactive.protein...Instance.0`,                                                                   
    `Albumin...Instance.0.participant...p23479_i0.`,                                                     
    `Albumin...Instance.0.participant...p30600_i0.`,                                                     
    `Alanine.aminotransferase...Instance.0`,                                                             
    `Alkaline.phosphatase...Instance.0`,                                                                 
    `Aspartate.aminotransferase...Instance.0`,                                                           
    `Calcium...Instance.0.participant...p30680_i0.`,                                                     
    `Calcium...Instance.0.participant...p100024_i0.`,                                                    
    `Gamma.glutamyltransferase...Instance.0`,                                                            
    `Direct.bilirubin...Instance.0`,                                                                     
    `Total.bilirubin...Instance.0`,                                                                      
    `Haemoglobin.concentration...Instance.0`,                                                            
    `Platelet.count...Instance.0`,                                                                       
    `White.blood.cell..leukocyte..count...Instance.0`,                                                   
    `Red.blood.cell..erythrocyte..count...Instance.0`,
    starts_with("baseline_"),
    starts_with("incident_"),
    starts_with("date_first_"),
    ends_with("cancer"),
    ckd_incident_date
  )

# Verify the selected columns
head(relevant_pheno_vars)

# Join with the main analysis dataframe
analysis_df_pheno <- analysis_df %>% left_join(relevant_pheno_vars, by = "Participant.ID")

# Create a simplified smoking status variable
analysis_df_pheno <- analysis_df_pheno %>%  
  mutate(
    smoking_status_current_previous = case_when(
      `Smoking.status...Instance.0` %in% c("Current", "Previous") ~ 1,
      `Pack.years.of.smoking...Instance.0` > 0 ~ 1,
      `Smoking.status...Instance.0` == "Never" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

# Check the data for completeness
skimr::skim(analysis_df_pheno)
```
